digest.component_or_area: Cloud rate-limit sweep / Jira adapter transport layer
propositions: The rate-limit sweep's file list is hardcoded rather than derived from package structure, creating risk that renamed or relocated transport methods escape the sweep
Two existing transport facade methods (backend.py::set_relationship and backend.py::add_comment) delegate unchanged to self.transport with the same name, representing the benign collision pattern
An anti-drift assertion must distinguish pure delegating facades from actual transport logic by AST inspection to permit only passthrough calls with arguments forwarded unchanged
The sweep's scope is intentionally scoped to the transport layer (four modules) rather than the entire jira package to keep the 429 policy surface manageable
A guard rejecting classified mutating names outside swept modules unless they are pure transport facades prevents silent scope expansion and catches method renames that would evade the sweep
